voltbridge.title: Connect to MyGrid VoltBridge
voltbridge.description: Enter the address of the VoltBridge P1 meter. It must have received at least one P1 telegram.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the VoltBridge, for example 192.168.0.45 or voltbridge-D02D80.local.
IP address or hostname of the VoltBridge, for example 192.168.0.45 or voltbridge-D02D80.local.

error.voltbridge_invalid_host: Enter a hostname or an IP address, without a scheme, port or path.
error.voltbridge_cannot_connect: Cannot reach the VoltBridge. Check the address and that it is on the same network.
error.voltbridge_no_data: The VoltBridge is reachable but has not received a P1 telegram yet. Check the P1 cable and try again.

abort.not_voltbridge: The discovered device is not a VoltBridge.
abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different meter.
abort.voltbridge_no_data: The discovered VoltBridge has not received a P1 telegram yet.

voltbridge_init.title: Polling
voltbridge_init.description: Live power arrives by UDP push about once a second, or is read from the device once a second while UDP broadcasts are lost or do not reach Home Assistant. The HTTP snapshot, which carries gas and totals, and the telegram are refreshed at this interval.

data_description.poll_interval: How often the full HTTP snapshot, the telegram and the status are read. Live power does not depend on it.

voltbridge_no_data.message: The VoltBridge has not received a P1 telegram yet.

voltbridge_command_failed.message: The VoltBridge could not be rebooted.

no_p1_data.title: VoltBridge receives no P1 data
no_p1_data.description: The VoltBridge is reachable but has stopped receiving P1 telegrams from the meter. Check that the P1 cable is plugged into the meter's P1 port and that the meter's P1 port is enabled. This issue clears itself when data returns.
